definitions.wordBreakdownExists: An authored breakdown exists on the fixture occurrence, shared teaching lesson, or import word record.
definitions.breakdownMode: Authored parts are atomic when there is one part and segmented when there is more than one. Legacy and fallback modes are reported separately.
definitions.sourcePartsConcatenateExactly: Compared using the same NFC, whitespace and tatweel normalization as validateWordBreakdown.
definitions.validAtomicCount: Counts authored one-part WordBreakdown records only; safe runtime whole-word fallbacks are separate.

atomicAndSegmentedModes.detail: Inferred from parts length; no explicit mode property or enum.

stablePartIds.detail: Part records have order but no stable part id.

orderedParts.detail: order is required as an integer, but uniqueness and contiguous ordering are enforced only by runtime validation.

occurrenceLevelOverrides.detail: A word record can contain breakdown.

sharedTeachingBreakdowns.detail: The package schema has teachingId and occurrence breakdowns but no shared teaching-entry schema; TypeScript fixtures support lesson.breakdown.

testCoverageAssessment.authoredBreakdownCoverage: Only the second word of āyah 1 in 113 and 114 (أَعُوذُ) is tested.
testCoverageAssessment.allOccurrenceCoverage: No test audits every visible occurrence in 109–114.
testCoverageAssessment.specialWords: No test covers بِرَبِّ, وَلَمْ, لَّهُۥ, وَٱلنَّاسِ, قُلْ, or rootless atomic fallback behavior.
testCoverageAssessment.schemaCoverage: No test validates atomic/segmented mode, stable part ids, ordering invariants, or overrides against word.schema.json.

categoryDefinitions.validSegmented: Authored WordBreakdown, more than one part, complete source concatenation and metadata.
categoryDefinitions.validAtomic: Authored one-part whole-word WordBreakdown passing validation.
categoryDefinitions.missing: No authored WordBreakdown; includes source-only records and custom lessons using whole-word fallback.
categoryDefinitions.invalidOrIncomplete: Legacy parts do not concatenate to the complete canonical word.
categoryDefinitions.legacyComponentData: Legacy parts concatenate completely but are not an explicit WordBreakdown and lack required kind metadata.

sharedWordsMayNeedOverrides.reason: Shared وَ is used for وَمِن and وَٱلنَّاسِ; the latter needs a complete occurrence-specific split.
Shared lesson is used for مِن and مِنَ; the final-vowel occurrence needs an occurrence-aware source/display decision.
112:1 is glossed uniquely One while 112:4 is glossed anyone.
Repeated ٱلنَّاسِ occurrences have different sentence roles.
The repeated form has a distinct occurrence role in 112:2.

specialConfirmations.أَعُوذُ: Valid shared segmented breakdown: أَ + عُوذُ. Import packages also contain occurrence-level copies. displayText أَـ does not alter sourceText.
specialConfirmations.بِرَبِّ: Legacy only: بِ + رَبِّ concatenates exactly, but there is no authored WordBreakdown and no kind metadata.
specialConfirmations.وَلَمْ: Legacy only: وَ + لَمْ concatenates exactly, but there is no authored WordBreakdown and no kind metadata.
specialConfirmations.لَّهُۥ: Invalid/incomplete legacy data: current لِ + هُ does not concatenate to canonical لَّهُۥ.
specialConfirmations.وَٱلنَّاسِ: Incomplete shared legacy data: lesson:wa supplies only وَ; an occurrence-specific complete breakdown is required.
specialConfirmations.قُلْ: No authored breakdown and no fabricated split; runtime safely falls back to the complete word atomically.
specialConfirmations.rootlessParticles: An authored one-part atomic breakdown is safe, but none currently exist.
specialConfirmations.displayJoiningLines: Validation uses sourceText; display-only joining lines remain outside canonical source concatenation.
